comparison.minimum_valid_run_set: COMPLETE requires exactly one verified record for every manifest schedule ordinal; STOPPED_OPERATIONAL_FAILURE requires exactly one verified record for the prefix through the hash-bound stop ordinal

run_metrics.mean_total_cost_to_accepted_result_micro: sum(total_cost_to_accepted_result_micro_units where final_accepted = true) / count(records where final_accepted = true)
run_metrics.frontier_usage_calls: count(all provider usage entries whose frozen binding capability_class = strong over every scheduled record)
run_metrics.frontier_observed_tokens_by_category: sum observed input, output, cached-input and reasoning token fields separately for all provider usage entries whose frozen binding capability_class = strong
run_metrics.frontier_observed_cost_micro_units: sum(cost_observed for all provider usage entries whose frozen binding capability_class = strong over every scheduled record)
run_metrics.post_acceptance_defect_incidence_rate: count(final_accepted = true AND post_acceptance_defects is not empty) / count(final_accepted = true)

field_semantics.first_pass_accepted: true only when final_accepted is true, attempts = 1, repairs = 0 and escalations = 0
field_semantics.reviewer_rejected: true when any reviewer rejection occurred during the run; a later repair or escalation may still produce final acceptance
field_semantics.human_intervention_rate: count(human_interventions > 0) / count(records), with human_intervention_seconds > 0 requiring human_interventions > 0
field_semantics.frontier_usage_calls: all strong-capability orchestrator, executor and reviewer usage is counted; executor-only usage cannot support frontier_usage_reduced

paired_interpretation.quality_preserved: candidate.final_acceptance_rate >= baseline.final_acceptance_rate AND candidate.false_acceptance_rate <= baseline.false_acceptance_rate AND candidate.post_acceptance_defect_incidence_rate <= baseline.post_acceptance_defect_incidence_rate
paired_interpretation.operational_failure: run_set_status = STOPPED_OPERATIONAL_FAILURE OR any authority escape, durable state inconsistency, critical false acceptance, cross-run contamination or unreconstructable evidence
paired_interpretation.insufficient_evidence: run_set_status = COMPLETE AND (run-set incomplete OR either route has no final accepted result denominator)
